text:
Leave Policy (HR-001)
1. Purpose and Scope
This policy defines the types of leave available to all full-time employees of Nexora Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
It is effective from 1 April 2026 and replaces the 2024 Leave Policy (version 2.1).
Leave is recorded and approved through the NexHR portal. Contract and intern staff are covered by their
own agreements.
title: Leave Policy

text:
Leave Policy (HR-001)
2. Types of Leave
Leave Type | Entitlement | Rules
Annual Leave (Earned Leave) | 24 days per year | Accrues at 2 days per month. Up to 10 unused days can be carried forward.
Casual Leave | 8 days per year | Cannot be carried forward. Maximum 3 consecutive days at a time.
Sick Leave | 12 days per year | A medical certificate is required for more than 2 consecutive days. Not carried forward.
Maternity Leave | 26 weeks | Applies to the first two children. For a third child the entitlement is 12 weeks.
Paternity Leave | 15 working days | Must be taken within 6 months of the child's birth.
Bereavement Leave | 5 days | For the death of an immediate family member.
Marriage Leave | 5 days | Available once during the employee's tenure.
Compensatory Off | 1 day per approved weekend working day | Must be used within 60 days of being earned.
title: Leave Policy

text:
Leave Policy (HR-001)
3. How to Apply for Leave
- Apply through the NexHR portal under Leave > New Request.
- Leave of more than 2 days must be applied for at least 3 working days in advance.
- Planned leave of more than 5 consecutive days needs manager approval at least 14 days in advance.
- For sick leave, inform your manager before 10:00 AM on the day of absence and update NexHR within
24 hours.
title: Leave Policy

text:
Leave Policy (HR-001)
4. Carry Forward and Encashment
A maximum of 10 unused annual leave days can be carried forward to the next leave year. The leave year
runs from 1 April to 31 March. Any balance above 10 days lapses on 31 March.
At separation, up to 15 days of accumulated annual leave can be encashed. Encashment is calculated as
basic salary divided by 30 for each day.
Employees who join during the year receive annual leave pro-rated by the month of joining.
title: Leave Policy

text:
Leave Policy (HR-001)
5. Public Holidays
Nexora observes 12 company holidays each year. The holiday list is published in December for the
following year. In addition, every employee can choose 2 optional holidays from a list of 6.

6. Unauthorised Absence
Absence of more than 3 consecutive days without informing the manager is treated as unauthorised
absence and may lead to action under the Disciplinary Procedure (HR-007).
title: Leave Policy

text:
Code of Conduct (HR-002)
1. Our Values
Nexora's four core values are Integrity, Ownership, Curiosity and Respect. Every employee is expected to act in line with these values in all dealings with colleagues, customers, vendors and the public.

2. Workplace Behaviour
- Treat every colleague with dignity. Discrimination based on gender, caste, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation or region is not tolerated.
- Use company resources, such as laptops, email and Slack, mainly for business purposes.
- Do not take part in bullying, intimidation or retaliation against anyone who raises a concern.
title: Code of Conduct

text:
Code of Conduct (HR-002)
3. Conflict of Interest and Gifts
Employees must disclose any outside business interest, directorship or financial interest in a vendor, customer or competitor to HR within 7 days of becoming aware of it.
Gifts with a value of more than Rs. 3,000 must be declared to your manager and the Ethics team. Cash or cash equivalents, such as gift cards, must never be accepted.
title: Code of Conduct

text:
Code of Conduct (HR-002)
4. Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH)
Nexora has an Internal Committee (IC) under the POSH Act. Complaints can be sent to ic@nexora.example. The IC completes its inquiry within 90 days of receiving a complaint. All complaints are handled confidentially.
title: Code of Conduct

text:
Code of Conduct (HR-002)
5. Reporting Concerns and Whistleblower Protection
Concerns about unethical or illegal conduct can be reported to your manager, to HR, or anonymously through the Ethics Hotline at 1800-555-0199 (toll-free, 24x7). Nexora does not tolerate retaliation against anyone who reports a concern in good faith.
title: Code of Conduct

text:
Code of Conduct (HR-002)
6. Confidentiality and Social Media
Do not share confidential company, customer or employee information outside Nexora. Do not speak on behalf of Nexora on social media unless authorised by Corporate Communications. Personal opinions posted online must not suggest that they represent the company.
title: Code of Conduct

text:
Hybrid and Remote Work Policy (HR-003)
1. Hybrid Model
Nexora follows a hybrid model. Employees work from the office on three fixed days, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. Monday and Friday are flexible, and employees may work from home on those days without prior approval.
Core collaboration hours are 11:00 to 16:00 IST. Employees must be available for meetings during these hours wherever they work from.
title: Hybrid and Remote Work Policy

text:
Hybrid and Remote Work Policy (HR-003)
2. Allowances and Reimbursements
Item | Amount | Conditions
Home-office allowance | Rs. 1,500 per month | Paid to all hybrid employees with payroll.
Internet reimbursement | Up to Rs. 1,000 per month | Submit the monthly broadband bill in NexExpense.
Ergonomic setup grant | Rs. 10,000 one-time | Available after 6 months of service for a chair or desk.
title: Hybrid and Remote Work Policy

text:
Hybrid and Remote Work Policy (HR-003)
3. Work From Anywhere
- Employees may work from anywhere in India for up to 20 days per calendar year with manager approval.
- International work from anywhere is limited to 10 days per year and needs approval from the VP of your function and from the Security team.
- Fully remote roles need approval from the VP of the function and are reviewed every 12 months.
title: Hybrid and Remote Work Policy

text:
Hybrid and Remote Work Policy (HR-003)
4. Security Requirements for Remote Work
- Always connect to the company VPN (GlobalConnect) when working outside a Nexora office.
- Do not use public Wi-Fi without the VPN switched on.
- Lock your screen when away and never leave a company laptop in a car or unattended in public places.
title: Hybrid and Remote Work Policy

text:
Hybrid and Remote Work Policy (HR-003)
5. Meetings
Cameras should be on for client meetings and for team meetings of fewer than 10 people. Use the Slack status to show when you are away.
title: Hybrid and Remote Work Policy

text:
Performance Review Process (HR-005)
1. Review Cycle
Performance is reviewed twice a year. The mid-year review takes place in October and the annual review
in April. Employees set quarterly OKRs with their managers at the start of every quarter.

2. Rating Scale
Rating | Label | Meaning
1 | Needs Improvement | Performance is well below expectations for the level.
2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all expectations.
3 | Meets Expectations | Consistently delivers what is expected for the level.
4 | Exceeds Expectations | Regularly delivers more than expected.
5 | Outstanding | Exceptional impact beyond the level; top 5% of the organisation.
title: Performance Review Process

text:
Performance Review Process (HR-005)
3. 360-Degree Feedback
360-degree feedback from peers and reports is collected for employees at level L4 and above. Feedback
is anonymous and is summarised by HR.

4. Annual Bonus Link
The annual performance bonus is paid as a percentage of the target bonus, based on the April rating:
Rating | Bonus Payout
1 or 2 | 0% of target bonus
3 | 100% of target bonus
4 | 120% of target bonus
5 | 150% of target bonus
title: Performance Review Process

text:
Performance Review Process (HR-005)
5. Promotions
To be eligible for promotion an employee needs at least 18 months in the current level and a rating of 4 or
above in two consecutive review cycles. Promotions are effective from 1 May.

6. Performance Improvement Plan (PIP)
An employee rated 1, or rated 2 in two consecutive cycles, may be placed on a 60-day Performance
Improvement Plan. The PIP sets clear goals and has a check-in every 2 weeks. Failure to meet the PIP
goals may lead to action under the Disciplinary Procedure (HR-007).
title: Performance Review Process

Employees at level L4 and above are eligible for ESOP grants. Grants vest over 4 years with a 1-year cliff: 25% vests after the first year, and the remaining 75% vests in equal monthly instalments over the next 36 months.
title: Compensation Bands and Equity

text:
Disciplinary Procedure (HR-007)
1. Purpose
This procedure explains how Nexora handles misconduct and repeated poor performance. It is intended
for HR and people managers.

2. Stages of Action
Stage | Action | Typical Use
1 | Verbal warning | Minor first-time breaches such as repeated lateness.
2 | Written warning | Repeat of a minor breach or a moderate breach.
3 | Final written warning | Continued breach after a written warning.
4 | Termination | Failure after a final warning or serious misconduct.
title: Disciplinary Procedure

text:
Disciplinary Procedure (HR-007)
3. Investigation Timeline
HR must complete an investigation within 15 working days of receiving a complaint. The employee has the
right to respond in writing within 5 working days of receiving the allegation. The employee may be
accompanied by a colleague at any hearing.
title: Disciplinary Procedure

text:
Disciplinary Procedure (HR-007)
4. Serious Misconduct
Fraud, harassment, theft, data theft and violence are serious misconduct. The employee may be
suspended with pay during the inquiry. If the allegation is proven, Nexora may terminate employment
immediately without notice.

5. Termination Notice and Appeals
For termination without cause the notice period is 60 days (or pay in lieu). An employee can appeal any
disciplinary decision to the HR Head within 10 working days of receiving the decision. The HR Head's
decision is final.
title: Disciplinary Procedure
section: 4. Serious Misconduct / 5. Termination Notice and Appeals

text:
VPN Setup Guide (IT-003)
1. Overview
Nexora uses the GlobalConnect VPN client. The VPN is required whenever you work outside
a Nexora office, including from home.

2. Installation Steps
* Open the Software Portal (software.nexora.example) and search for GlobalConnect.
* Click Install. The minimum supported client version is 5.2.
* Open GlobalConnect and enter the server address vpn.nexora.example.
* Sign in with your SSO credentials, then approve the MFA prompt in the NexAuth
app.
* Wait for the status to show Connected.
title: VPN Setup Guide

text:
VPN Setup Guide (IT-003)
3. Usage Rules
* Split tunnelling is disabled. All traffic goes through the company network while
connected.
* A session disconnects automatically after 8 hours of inactivity.
* A single account can be connected from at most 2 devices at the same time.
title: VPN Setup Guide

text:
VPN Setup Guide (IT-003)
4. Troubleshooting
Error | Meaning | Fix
806 | Port 443 is blocked by your network | Try a different network, such as a mobile hotspot, or ask your ISP to allow TCP port 443.
691 | Credentials rejected | Reset your password at pwreset.nexora.example and sign in again.
720 | Outdated client | Update GlobalConnect from the Software Portal to version 5.2 or later.
If none of these fixes work, raise a P2 ticket with the helpdesk and attach a screenshot
of the error.
-- End of IT-003 --
title: VPN Setup Guide

text:
Information Security Policy (SEC-001)
1. Passwords and Authentication
- Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.
- Passwords must be changed every 180 days, and the last 10 passwords cannot be reused.
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) using the NexAuth app is mandatory for all employees and all
company systems.
- Never share your password or MFA codes with anyone, including IT staff.
title: Information Security Policy

text:
Information Security Policy (SEC-001)
2. Data Classification
Class | Examples | Handling
Public | Marketing material, published blogs | No restrictions.
Internal | Policies, internal wiki, org charts | Share only within Nexora.
Confide ntial | Customer contracts, source code, financial reports | Share on a need-to-know basis. Encrypt when sending outside.
Restrict ed | Customer personal data, credentials, compensation data | Access only to named individuals. Encrypted at all times. Logged access.
title: Information Security Policy

text:
Information Security Policy (SEC-001)
3. Use of AI Tools
Public AI chatbots and online AI tools may be used only with data classified as Public. Employees must
not paste Internal, Confidential or Restricted data, including source code and customer information, into
public AI tools. The company-approved internal assistant may be used with Internal data and with
Confidential data that the employee is already authorised to access.
title: Information Security Policy

text:
Information Security Policy (SEC-001)
4. Phishing and Suspicious Emails
Use the Report Phish button in your email client or forward the email to phishing@nexora.example. Do not
click links or open attachments in suspicious emails. The Security team runs phishing simulations every
quarter.
title: Information Security Policy

text:
Information Security Policy (SEC-001)
5. Encryption and Access Reviews
Data at rest must be encrypted with AES-256 and data in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher. Managers review
their team's system access every quarter, and access is removed on the last working day of an employee.

6. Security Training
All employees must complete Security Awareness training within 30 days of joining and every year after
that.
title: Information Security Policy
section: 5. Encryption and Access Reviews / 6. Security Training

text:
Security Incident Response Plan (SEC-002)
1. Reporting an Incident
Any suspected security incident must be reported within 1 hour of discovery to security@nexora.example or to the 24x7 Security Hotline at +91-80-5550-0911.

2. Severity Levels
Severity | Definition | Response Time
P1 Critical | Confirmed data breach, ransomware, or customer-facing outage caused by an attack | 15 minutes
P2 High | Compromised employee account or malware on multiple devices | 1 hour
P3 Medium | Single malware detection or policy violation with limited impact | 4 hours
P4 Low | Informational events or failed attack attempts | 1 business day
title: Security Incident Response Plan

text:
Security Incident Response Plan (SEC-002)
3. Response Phases
- Detect and triage: SOC analyst confirms the incident and assigns severity.
- Contain: isolate affected systems and revoke compromised credentials.
- Eradicate: remove malware and close the vulnerability.
- Recover: restore systems from clean backups and monitor.
- Review: hold a post-incident review within 5 business days of closure.
title: Security Incident Response Plan

text:
Security Incident Response Plan (SEC-002)
4. Roles
The Incident Commander is the CISO or a delegate named by the CISO. Legal handles regulator and customer communication. Corporate Communications handles press queries.

5. Regulatory Notification
- CERT-In must be notified within 6 hours of noticing a reportable cyber incident.
- For a personal data breach, the Data Protection Board is notified within 72 hours.
- Affected customers are notified within 72 hours of confirmation of a breach.
- Incident evidence and logs are retained for 1 year.
title: Security Incident Response Plan

with appropriate controls. These principles follow the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023.

2. Data Subject Requests

4. Purchase Orders And Payment
No PO, no payment: invoices without a valid PO are not paid. The standard payment term
is net 45 days from invoice receipt. MSME-registered vendors are paid within 30 days.

Employees must not take part in selecting a vendor where they or a relative has a
financial interest. Such interests must be declared to Finance and HR.

NexSupport is Nexora's AI-powered customer support platform. It brings email, live chat and WhatsApp conversations into a single inbox, suggests or sends automatic replies using AI, routes tickets to the right team, and tracks SLA timers. Version 4.7 was released in September 2026.
